en.headline: Repulse Bay Motoring Classics brings rare cars to south side today
en.dek: The Peninsula-inspired garden party at The Repulse Bay Arcade runs from 2pm to 6:30pm, with classic icons and regional debuts on show.
body: The Repulse Bay is holding its first Motoring Classics event this afternoon, bringing a collection of rare classic cars and new regional premieres to the south side of Hong Kong Island.

Organisers said the garden party runs from 2pm to 6:30pm at The Repulse Bay Arcade on Repulse Bay Road. Highlights include a Rolls-Royce Phantom, Ferrari F40 and Lamborghini Miura among the classics, alongside regional first appearances of a Pagani Huayra Codalunga Speedster and Lamborghini Revuelto SV, and the Hong Kong debut of the Rolls-Royce Spectre Series II.
Tickets are priced at HK$850 for adults and HK$425 for children aged 5 to 11. The organisers said the afternoon also includes canapes from Arcade restaurants, free-flow champagne and live music.

zh.headline: 影灣園名車盛會今午淺水灣舉行 展出經典名車
zh.dek: 半島酒店集團風格的花園派對於影灣園購物商場下午2時至6時30分舉行，展出經典名車及地區首發車款。
body: 淺水灣影灣園今午首度舉辦名車盛會，將一系列珍稀經典名車及地區首發新車帶到港島南區。
主辦方表示，活動於下午2時至6時30分在淺水灣道109號影灣園購物商場舉行。展出車款包括勞斯萊斯幻影、法拉利F40及林寶堅尼Miura等經典座駕，並有帕加尼Huayra Codalunga Speedster及林寶堅尼Revuelto SV地區首度亮相，勞斯萊斯Spectre Series II則於香港首展。
門票成人每位850元，5至11歲小童每位425元。主辦方稱，當日另有商場餐廳美點、無限量香檳及現場音樂。
